title: Effects of gene knockout on Shigella proteome
projectDescription: We measured the impact of multiple genes on the proteome of Shigella.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were processed with a modified SP3 protocol, digested using trypsin and labeled with TMT. Shotgun proteomics using a Orbitrap Exploris 480 was then performed.
dataProcessingProtocol: TMT quantification was used, and data was processed by using MSFragger with the standard workflow.
